problem: The only exit path to ciphertext leaves from AddRoundKey and loops through MixColumns, so the diagram never shows the final round skipping MixColumns; a student reads the last 'round' as SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey once more.
fix: Route the last round through SubBytes and ShiftRows but bypass MixColumns before the final AddRoundKey, then draw the edge to ciphertext (label it 'final round: no MixColumns').

problem: 'Some syllabi call the family Rijndael' can be read as AES and Rijndael being the same thing; Rijndael also defines 192- and 256-bit blocks, which AES does not use.
fix: Write: AES is the Rijndael cipher fixed to a 128-bit block; Rijndael itself allows 128-, 192- and 256-bit blocks, but only the 128-bit-block versions are AES.
